title: 🏛️ RBI External Commercial Borrowing (ECB) Framework 2026 ($1B / 300% Net Worth)
executiveSummary: RBI notified FEMA Borrowing & Lending First Amendment Regulations 2026: Automatic ECB limit raised from $750M to higher of $1B or 300% net worth; minimum 3-year maturity; acquisition of control permitted.
